name: Virago: Herstory 2
detailed_description:
Virago Herstory 2 is a psychological detective game that continues Willow’s disturbing journey through a town wrapped in fear, silence, and suspicion. Set shortly after the events of the first game, Willow finds herself drawn into a new investigation, one that forces her to confront people from her past and present while dealing with the trauma that continues to haunt her.

You play as Willow, a young girl caught between hallucination and reality. As reports of violence and strange behavior spread through the town, she becomes entangled in a series of unsettling encounters, each more intense than the last. You’ll need to question suspects, analyze scenes, and find your way through a world where the line between truth and delusion is thin.

The game features tense interrogations, atmospheric environments, and unpredictable shifts in tone and perception. With no exaggerated powers, Virago Herstory 2 builds its fear through silence, pacing, and emotional weight.

This is not a game about saving the world. It’s about understanding it, even when it doesn’t understand you back.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-Bit
  • Processor: Intel CPUs - Dual Core 2.2 GHz to Quad Core 3.2GHz; AMD CPUS - Dual Core 2.4Ghz to Quad Core 3.2Ghz
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce 8600 GT 512MB to NVIDIA GeForce GTX 580 1536MB or Radeon HD3000 512MB to Radeon HD 6850 1024MB
  • Storage: 700 MB available space
